resources.string: The Catch Records service will be available from 1 October 2026.
To edit trips or manage your account settings, use the web service.

Check the How to record a catch tab to make sure you are recording your catches at the correct time.
You must record all catches unless an exemption applies.\n\nWe\'ll ask whether you caught any species subject to catch limits (quota).
Create your catch record before moving your catch off the vessel if you:
caught any species subject to catch limits (quota)
crossed an ICES area boundary while fishing
You need to create your catch record within 24 hours of landing your catch.

If you fish in or cross ICES areas 4c, 7d or 7e, you must create a separate catch record each time you cross a boundary.\n\nIf you need to record catches without an internet connection, use the mobile app.

Call 0300 020 3788, Monday to Friday, 8am to 6pm.

Calls to 03 numbers cost the same as calls to 01 or 02 numbers.

Outside these hours, leave a catch record on our automated line.
